admin.heading: Safety contacts
admin.intro: These numbers and links show in every report form and on the help pages. Check each one against its official source every month, then confirm it or change it.
admin.introReadOnly: These numbers and links show in every report form and on the help pages. Support keeps them up to date; you can read them here.

checks.heading: This month’s checks
checks.intro: Each month every country gets a check. It closes once every contact is confirmed or changed.
checks.none: No checks yet. The first opens on the 1st of next month.
